metadata.title: Reasoning Kernel: A Capability-Mediated Reference Architecture for Untrusted Tool Data in LLM Agents
metadata.description:
Working paper / technical note describing Reasoning Kernel, a Python reference implementation of a strong, CaMeL-like architecture for LLM agents: every model is treated as untrusted compute; planner inputs are mediated; no model output becomes a durable effect except through a deterministic Gate with capability and provenance checks.

Scope is honest: topology and reference software (PyPI capability-reasoning-kernel), not a security product, peer-reviewed evaluation, or safety certificate. Host policy remains the residual risk surface. Companion essay: Untrusted Data Must Not Own Control Flow (2026-10-02). Software: gianlucamazza/reasoning-kernel.

Italian abstract (short): Implementazione di riferimento in Python di un reasoning kernel a capability (forma forte, affine a CaMeL) che separa testo non fidato ed effetti autorizzati. È una topologia, non una certificazione.

No DOI is claimed in the uploaded PDF until Zenodo assigns one. Do not conflate with emotional-memory Zenodo records.
